name: Tako (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tako town emblem in blue and yellow: a blue ring with three spokes enclosing a yellow disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tako, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 June 1975.

features.role: Tako town emblem — a blue ring with three spokes enclosing a yellow disc
